methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This study explores innovative methodologies for estimating the energy baseline (EnBL) of a university classroom building

paper_type.evidence_quote: A classroom building on the UAO University campus (Figure 3), is studied as an application of the EnBL.

stage1.notes: Level-3A eligible: characterises four EnBL/EnPI models (time series, univariate & multivariate linear regression, EnergyPlus/Design Builder simulation) for one university classroom building at UAO campus, Colombia. Buildings sector -> not continuous process (level_3b=false). Time-series forecasting family coded 'other'. paper_type has a methodological-comparison flavour but is anchored to one empirical case.

ems_standard.evidence_quote: This proposed Energy Management System (EMS) finds its foundation in the tenets of ISO 50001, harmonizing seamlessly with the pragmatic directives delineated in ISO 50006.

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: Four methodologies are proposed: time series models, univariate regression models, multivariate regression models, and dynamic simulations using Design Builder software.
